independence_declaration.statement: release-auditor authored no implementation, test, register row, ADR, review or finding fix in the DG3 scope. That includes the five F-DG3-100 repairs (KBE-D..H), ARCH-05, FE-G and KBE-I. I audited the frozen candidate directly, in a complete disposable clone ($TMPDIR/c, not shallow, fsck clean) at source d3e6fe62. I checked the three round-7 specialist records and the code-security verification sidecar, the run metadata and sandbox files of every DG3 run, findings.json, stages.json and decisions D-078..D-087, and the cited evidence content. I reproduced pnpm test and the formula fuzz/lint test myself. My only writes are my evidence under docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG3/audit/round-7/ and this record and the gate record, written with the Write tool.

Recompute the candidate in the working tree and in the clone at the source commit (also after an offline install and build there). Confirm HEAD descends from the source commit with no change outside docs/delivery. Run the previous gates historically and the register rules at DG3.

checks_run.environment: repository HEAD 0cb2898 (descendant of d3e6fe62; delivery metadata only); clone $TMPDIR/c; node v24.21.0; auditor sandbox
checks_run.expected: assignment sha 7a6dcf29...; complete clone; sha256:f55095db...bf6e0 with 757 files everywhere; DG2 and DG1 historical PASS; register PASS
checks_run.actual: Assignment sha256 7a6dcf2957f5...b493114f matches. Clone complete: is-shallow=false, 736 commits, fsck exit 0. d3e6fe62 is an ancestor of HEAD, and git diff d3e6fe62..HEAD outside docs/delivery is empty. Candidate sha256:f55095dbec364594d25a624261512239854f233d3ee0b5c8ecc210d1602bf6e0, 757 files, in the working tree, in the clone at d3e6fe62 (also after install and build) and at 0cb2898. It equals stages.json (state VERIFYING, frozen 2026-10-08T21:47:45Z), the manifest and all three round-7 records. 'PASS gate DG2 (historical)', 'PASS gate DG1 (historical)' and 'PASS register rules at DG3', each exit 0.

checks_run.procedure: Resolve each round-7 specialist record's invocation_reference to its run directory. Check meta.json (role, invocation_reference equality, exit_code, is_error, subtype, external_config_changed, bash_sandbox, process_sandbox_discarded, tool_authored) and that sha256(sandbox.json) equals meta.process_sandbox_sha256. Check the independence declarations against the authorship of every DG3 implementation run.

checks_run.expected: three distinct successful sandboxed round-7 runs; exit 0; empty external_config_changed; sandbox hashes match; no reviewer among the implementation roles
checks_run.actual: domain 07643801, code-security 2c76861e, qa fd289c52: three distinct run_ids and session_ids. Each meta's invocation_reference equals its record, with the matching role, exit_code 0, is_error false, subtype success, external_config_changed [], bash_sandbox true, process_sandbox_discarded [] and a matching sandbox.json sha256. tool_authored holds only each role's own round-7 review files. Every DG3 implementation run (ARCH-01..05, BE-A..G, KBE-A..I, FE-A0..G, AN-P3/P3B) was run by an implementer role; no reviewer role implemented any DG3 requirement, and each record declares reviewer_authored_reviewed_scope=false. meta.outputs is the shared-tree pre/post diff (run-agent.sh snapshot): it lists the concurrent reviewers' round-7 evidence too, so authorship is taken from tool_authored, as in rounds 1-6.

checks_run.procedure: Read the three round-7 records: verdict, candidate, source, findings and every check's result.
checks_run.expected: three PASS verdicts on f55095db / d3e6fe62; no BLOCKED or FAIL check; no new finding
checks_run.actual: domain PASS (13 checks), code-security PASS (22 checks), qa PASS (26 checks), all on sha256:f55095db...bf6e0 and d3e6fe62. Every check is PASS and none is BLOCKED; findings [] in all three. Three qa checks carry exit_status 1 with PASS (QA-R7-01b, 04 and 07b). Each is explained: the deliberate negative probe, and qa's own F180b probe failing only at 390 px + 200% text, identical to rounds 3-6.

checks_run.procedure: For each of the five DG3 findings, check: status; a verifier who is not the owner; fix_revision an ancestor of d3e6fe62; and the verifying run's exit, config, sandbox and evidence existence. Then judge the F-DG3-100 closure against the reviewer's round-5 final criterion and ADR-0024 §6, spot-checking §6's factual claims in the clone.
checks_run.command: python3 over findings.json + runs; git merge-base --is-ancestor <fix> d3e6fe62; grep of the seven engine sources and decimal.js 10.6.0; read ADR-0024 §6 and the round-5/6/7 code-security verifications
checks_run.expected: 5/5 CLOSED_VERIFIED by non-owners with ancestor fixes and clean verifying runs; §6 claims only what the code guarantees, with an honest residual
checks_run.actual:
5 DG3 findings, all CLOSED_VERIFIED, none mandatory, 0 Critical/High.
- F-DG3-120 (Low): owner solution-architect, verified by domain in run 478aac6a (round 2, finished before D-082, external_config_changed []); fix ea8e2de is an ancestor. Domain re-confirmed it in round 7 (33/33 API, UI EN/AR).
- F-DG3-170 (Medium): owner frontend-ux-engineer, verified by domain in run 60f6afce (round 3); fix 6b30768 is an ancestor.
- F-DG3-180 (Medium): verified by the qa rerun 7b0434bc (R3B, D-084); fix 6b30768 is an ancestor.
- F-DG3-100 (Low): owner kpi-benefits-engineer, closed by code-security in round 6 (run 4bb03630) on 7049d793; fix 53ac073 is an ancestor.
- F-DG3-280 (Low): closed by code-security in round 7 (run 2c76861e); fix 1cd89e6 is an ancestor.
Every verifying run has exit 0, external_config_changed [] and a matching sandbox, and every cited verification evidence file exists.

F-DG3-100 judgement: the closure is sound.
- The round-5 final criterion offered (b) narrow §6 to enumerated claims and state the residual, or (a) refuse G1/G2/A1 and drop the absolute wording. Round 6 shows both met with the reviewer's own verbatim probes, and round 7 re-ran all five probes with byte-identical verdicts.
- §6 now states 'Each one refuses only what is listed for it here; none of them proves that the engine generates no code' and lists lint's L1-L7 exactly.
- The residual is honest. It names unexercised paths (Q1-Q5) and 'A self-handling form outside the list L1-L7, even on an exercised path, is refused by no layer', which code-security demonstrated with A3.
- I checked the factual claims myself. There are exactly five catch clauses in the seven closure files, each beginning 'if (e instanceof EvalError) throw e;'. The closure files have no finally, generator, yield, async, await, Promise, then, fromAsync, asyncIterator, eval or Function. decimal.js 10.6.0 has those words only in comments and no function*. The imports are only ./*.ts, ../value.ts and decimal.js. The CSP has useDefaults:false and scriptSrc 'self'.
- My own run of fuzz.test.ts passes 111/111, including the lintText test over G1/G2/A1/A2/F1 and every lintable probe row.

checks_run.procedure: Read D-078..D-087 in decisions.md verbatim, and judge the limitations and disclosures the assignment names.

checks_run.actual:
All ten decisions are recorded with their rationale.
- D-078 records the plan ('The solution-architect runs first and alone (T-DG3-ARCH-01)') and the correction: 'That summary was wrong. ... The records were accurate; only the orchestrator's paraphrase was not. From now on, assignments quote decisions verbatim from this file.'
- D-079 records 'Twenty-three implementer runs ran in waves', integration edits 'limited to test kits, test pins or document wording', and three disclosed limitations. I judge each acceptable as disclosed for DG3:
  - 'the role name is the server's labelEn data ... so it can appear in English in Arabic'. Bilingual API messages are owned by REQ-S15-007 (DG6, SPECIFIED), and the refusal still names the item and the missing criterion.
  - 'A Finance-validation item names the record type, not the record's title'. The missing item stays identifiable.
  - 'rounding is NULL only on calculation rows written before 0027 (none exist in a fresh database)'.
- D-080: 'They are repaired instead, because accepting them would need the user's approval and both are small.'
- D-081: 'At the merge the orchestrator put both under one heading and renumbered them 23 (KBE-D) and 24 (ARCH-05), keeping their texts verbatim.'
- D-082: quoted under AUD-R7-5; the rule 'no worktree creation or removal, no install ... while any review or audit run is active' held.
- D-083: 'The orchestrator accepts the change' to the root test script. It is acceptable, because without it unit-formula-nocodegen is not in pnpm test; I ran pnpm test and both invocations executed. The flaky unit-web test is disclosed.
- D-084..D-087 record the round 3-6 results and the KBE-F/G/H/I repairs, each with merged-tree verification.
- The session-identity.test.tsx flake under load (D-083, D-084) is acceptable as disclosed. It is a DG2 test, it passed on every rerun and isolated repeat, and the round-7 runs were green on the first run, both mine and qa's. No specialist raised it.
Two record inaccuracies, neither affecting the gate:
  - D-083 says 'Both implementer runs report external_config_changed', but only FE-G's meta does; KBE-E's is []. This is an over-disclosure.
  - The ARCH-02 implementer run (2026-10-07, before any review) reports 39 '<path> removed' entries under /home/user/wt/dg3-kbe-a, the wave-1 worktree removed during its run, and D-079 does not mention it. This is implementer-only and warning-class (D-082), and the run's meta records it transparently.

summary:
Audit PASS on candidate sha256:f55095db...bf6e0 (757 files, source d3e6fe62), recomputed in a complete clone.
- Three independent, successful, sandboxed round-7 specialist runs, all PASS on this candidate. No new finding and no BLOCKED check.
- 5/5 DG3 findings CLOSED_VERIFIED by non-owners. Every fix is an ancestor of the candidate, and every verifying run is clean. 0 unresolved Critical/High findings and 0 mandatory violations.
- The F-DG3-100 closure is sound: ADR-0024 §6 claims only enumerated, checked behaviour, and its residual is honest.
- 32/32 DG3 requirements IMPLEMENTED and covered. DG2 and DG1 historical PASS; register PASS.
- The D-082 and D-084 incidents were handled acceptably, and the corrective rule held in rounds 3-7.
- Every non-zero exit in the cited logs is disclosed. I reproduced pnpm test: 1654, then 259 + 2 skipped.
- Non-blocking observations (no finding): the D-083 over-disclosure about KBE-E; the undisclosed ARCH-02 worktree-removal warning; the D-079 labelEn limitation and the F180b 390 px + 200% grid state, both carried to DG6 (REQ-S15-007, REQ-S15-009); the session-identity flake, acceptable as disclosed.
